name: Zenitsu Agatsuma
summary: After completing the Hashira Training, Zenitsu reached a level of skill comparable to the Hashira. He became an exceptionally skilled swordsman and entered the Infinity Castle capable of fighting Upper Rank demons. His experience and growth allowed him to adapt rapidly in battle, while his mastery of Thunder Breathing gave him access to powerful techniques including Godspeed and his personal Seventh Form, Flaming Thunder God.

stats.range: Extended Melee Range, Several Meters with Breathing Styles

notes: Zenitsu's Post-Hashira Training key. He possesses swordsmanship comparable to the Hashira and can react instinctively in combat. With Yushiro's talisman, he can conceal his presence, become invisible, perceive invisible beings and attacks, and detect power levels. His Godspeed and Seventh Form: Flaming Thunder God can reach Sub-Relativistic speeds according to the VS Battles profile.
